body:
Monthly weekly-product digest — fixture day 240, 2027-09-01.

The source audit withdraws the earlier activation-benefit conclusion for resumable setup. Measurement-10 corrects measurement-1/4/6/7: earlier assignment included existing customers; restricting to original eligible new users revises completed-project activation from 42%/49% to 42%/43%, with a 95% difference interval of -2 to +4 percentage points. This is a correction of the earlier comparison, not a new experiment; benefit, harm and equivalence are unestablished. Draft saves remain excluded from activation.

Retained use is separately 31%/32%, interval -1 to +3 points. No retained-use, sustained or commercial benefit is established. Sample sizes, assignment details, cohort dates and the retained-use event/window remain unspecified. Elapsed time and repeated observations do not resolve those gaps.

Actual deployment and adoption remain history: day-0 deployment effect-3 applied revision 2; day-14 adoption effect-8 closed the evaluation. Current state confirms save_setup=true, explicit_template=true, no active experiment for this responsibility and four related evaluations. The audit supersedes the evidence supporting the adoption rationale; it does not undo adoption. I left the configuration provisionally in place because its draft-persistence function was validated and current evidence shows no clear harm. This is a reversible operational judgment, not a claim of proven population benefit. The missing-draft support signal is 240 days old and conflicts with actual configuration.

This session preserved the audit and linked the correction to the original decision, checked related work and the shared ledger, and scheduled a review for day 254 (2027-09-15). Receipt effect-11 and current scheduler state confirm continuation. Next review will seek fresh eligible-cohort/retained-use evidence and current support signals; the same audit alone will not strengthen the result. No validation credits were spent; 9/10 shared credits are consumed with no reset. The responsibility remains active. Historical Quickstart and its unresolved solo-retention question remain separate.

Evidence: memory/evidence/day-240-initial.json; memory/actions/save-setup-day-240-audit.md; memory/actions/save-setup-day-14.md; memory/evidence/day-240-schedule-response.json; memory/evidence/day-240-status-after-schedule.json.
